getCurrentDay uses now which is block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
withinLimit calls getCurrentDay and depends on timestamp-based day.
withinExecutionLimit calls getCurrentDay and depends on timestamp-based day.
addTotalSpentPerDay receives current day derived from block.timestamp.
addTotalExecutedPerDay receives current day derived from block.timestamp.
withinLimit reads daily and per-tx limits from uintStorage.
withinExecutionLimit reads execution limits from uintStorage.
setDailyLimit writes daily limit to uintStorage.
setExecutionDailyLimit writes execution daily limit to uintStorage.
setExecutionMaxPerTx writes execution max per tx to uintStorage.
setMaxPerTx writes max per tx to uintStorage.
setMinPerTx writes min per tx to uintStorage.
_addRewardAddress writes linked list pointers to addressStorage.
OWNER key is used to read owner.
BRIDGE_CONTRACT key is used to read bridge contract.
MEDIATOR_CONTRACT key is used to read mediator contract.
REQUEST_GAS_LIMIT key is used to read request gas limit.
claimValues calls claimErc20Tokens for token address.
Proxy fallback performs delegatecall to implementation, enabling reentrancy through the proxy.
passMessage may call requireToPassMessage on the bridge.
passMessage may call requireToConfirmMessage on the bridge.
_distributeFee transfers ERC677 tokens to reward addresses.
onlyRelevantSender uses low-level .call to check upgradeability owner.
random uses blockhash and block.number, which is predictable.
ERC677 transfer can trigger onTokenTransfer callback.
ERC677 transferFrom can trigger onTokenTransfer callback.
ERC677 mint can trigger token transfer callback in some token implementations.
ERC677 burn can trigger token callback in some token implementations.
